title: 琥珀の隊商と霜宮の眠り
author: 砂原 オアシス

en.title: The Amber Caravan and the Slumber of the Frost Palace
en.premise: Saphia, the daughter of a fallen merchant house, embarks on a perilous journey to the legendary 'Ice Castle' in hopes of restoring her family's legacy. Her guide is a solitary man, the last keeper of the 'Old Lighthouse' that once illuminated the sea of sand. From the sweltering chaos of the markets to the frozen silence of nights where even the stars turn to ice, their path leads them to a hidden treasure capable of rewriting the laws of the world.

zh.title: 琥珀之商队与霜宫之眠
zh.premise: 没落商家的女儿萨菲亚，为了振兴家族，踏上了前往传说中“冰之城”的旅程。而她的向导，则是一位孤独的男子——他曾是照亮沙之海的“古老灯塔”的最后一名守护者。远离灼热市场的喧嚣，跨越连星辰都将冻结的深夜之静谧，两人最终将邂逅足以颠覆世界法则的秘宝。
